title: link_passages
description: Insert a link from one passage to another, using the link syntax of the story's declared format (arrow for Harlowe/Chapbook, pipe for SugarCube/Snowman).

display_text.description: The visible link label; when omitted, the link renders as [[to_passage]].

insertion_index.description: Character offset in from_passage.text; null = append.

rendered_syntax.description: The exact substring inserted into from_passage.text (e.g. '[[Go north->Forest]]').

clarification_triggers: to_passage does not exist: ask create_empty_passage | cancel (no silent creation)
from_passage does not exist: ask which passage was meant
